title: CheetahClaws
intro: CheetahClaws, headless over `cheetahclaws -p`, on an OpenAI chat-shaped provider through `CUSTOM_BASE_URL` and `CUSTOM_API_KEY`.
notes: Installed with pip into its own venv.
`max_tokens: 0` in its config stops it sending a `max_tokens` value newer OpenAI models refuse; the three interactive tools are disabled because nobody is there to answer them.
Its output is terminal text rather than JSON.
caveat: Headless CheetahClaws starts from an empty conversation every run (resume is a REPL command); it answers recall by looking at the workspace, not by remembering.
